title: tpu-vm-eval-node vars
description: Variables for Cloud TPU VM Evaluation and Training Node

TPU_NAME.description: Name of the TPU VM instance

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID where the TPU VM is provisioned

TPU_ZONE.description: Google Cloud Zone for the TPU VM (e.g. us-central2-b)

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: TPU accelerator version and topology (e.g. v4-8)

TPU_DATA_DISK_SIZE.description: Persistent data disk size in GB attached to the TPU VM

BUCKET_NAME.description: GCS bucket mounted via Cloud Storage FUSE for datasets and checkpoints

ML_SCRIPT.description: Evaluation or training command to execute on the TPU VM
